CHEZ MONA / CANVAS 101 / ABOUT 5 MINUTES

Build an order together

Agent interactions shouldn't be limited to chat.

A canvas is a shared workspace where you and the agent can see and change the same work.

This one is an order ticket. Others might be documents or project boards. You can make changes directly, not just describe them in chat.

Make a change yourself

Click Add Omelette in the menu.

Watch your ticket update. No chat prompt needed.

Let the agent make a change

Copy this prompt, paste it into chat, and send it.

Add two Soups to my ticket.

The agent updates the same ticket you just edited.

Check the result together

Remove one Soup from your ticket. Then send this prompt in chat.

Summarize my current order, including quantities.

Compare the agent's answer with your actual ticket. It can read your correction when asked.

Return to the Chez Mona launcher for the quiz.
